reasons: Kill criteria: net debt/EBITDA is 3.41 (figure from the data), below the 4x limit, so not met. A controlling shareholder who ruled out a sale: insiders hold 61.1%, which is a controlling-size stake, but the data is silent on any statement about selling, so this kill criterion cannot be checked and does not count as met. A major unresolved regulatory issue: the data is silent, so it cannot be checked either. No kill criterion is established, so no Reject.
